name: Target

window.note: Most unopened items sold by Target, in new condition.

basis.note: The official page doesn't say whether online orders count from delivery; the purchase date is the earlier one.

requirement.note: The page says items must be returned within the window but doesn't say how that applies to mail returns.

conditions.value: Most unopened items in new condition within 90 days. Electronics and entertainment 30 days; Apple, Beats and mobile phones 14 days; Target Owned Brands up to one year with a receipt.

processing.value: Up to 2 days after approval to a Target Circle Card, up to 5 days to another card; mail returns take about 7–10 business days before approval

categories.label: Electronics and entertainment (not Apple or Beats)
Apple and Beats products, including mobile phones
Mobile phones
categories.note: Phones on a carrier contract must be returned in a Target store with a Target Tech Rep and may trigger early termination fees.

categories.label: Target Owned Brands
categories.note: The Target Circle Card extra 30 days doesn't apply.

membership.effect: An extra 30 days on most items bought with the card at Target and Target.com.
An extra 30 days to return items.

holiday.note: Extended holiday window for electronics; the return-by date wasn't confirmed.

value.without: Stores can look up receipts for store and online purchases with certain cards, including Target Circle Card. Without proof of purchase, the refund may be a merchandise return card, and returns may be limited.

timing.value: Up to 2 days after approval to a Target Circle Card, up to 5 days to another card; mail returns take about 7–10 business days before approval

methods.label: Drive Up return
methods.cost: Free for purchases made with a Target.com account
steps: Open the Target app and start a Drive Up return
Drive to the store's Drive Up spots
Hand the item to the team member

methods.label: Return in store
steps: Open Wallet in the Target app to show your return barcode, or bring the receipt
Bring the item to Guest Services

methods.label: Mail it back
steps: Start the return from the order in your Target account
Use the free return label Target emails and shows on the order page
Pack the item and send it

marketplace.value: Target Plus partner items: most unopened items in new condition within 30 days, in store or by mail. Bring the receipt or original payment method for lookup; in-store returns without an eligible receipt are denied.

unknowns.note: Not confirmed whether the extra 30 days applies to electronics' 30-day window. Use the shorter window.
No 2026 holiday return extension published yet.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
